children: A French labour strike in the power sector is expected to reduce delivery capacity at the Dunkirk LNG terminal to 4 gigawatt-hours per day at 0700 GMT on Tuesday, Fluxys data showed.
The terminal normally delivers a minimum of 9.4 GWh per day, Fluxys data showed.
Power sector unions are protesting a recommendation to curb employee benefits such as access to cheaper power.
